eyebrow: Why the dependency map missed it

steps.label: "checkout-api depends on Key Vault"
steps.sub: True, but it never asked which region, or whether that vault was itself redundant

steps.label: The same blind spot, three disguises
steps.sub: A shared DNS provider, or a single identity tenant, fail the exact same way

steps.label: App-layer redundancy isn't enough
steps.sub: Every redundant copy still shared one invisible, unredundant dependency

steps.label: 1. Deploy wrenhaven-kv-centralus
steps.sub: A real, monitored second vault -- not a one-time manual copy

steps.label: 2-3. Local-first, tested fallback
steps.sub: Each region reads its own vault, never one hardcoded reference

steps.label: 4. Re-run the dependency map
steps.sub: Ask of every edge: is the other end itself redundant, or just assumed to be?
